$comment: Accepted drift for .ai/infra/scripts/drift-report.mjs. Every entry needs a reason, a reviewedAt, and an expiresAt (YYYY-MM-DD). Once expiresAt passes the finding fails again, so a baseline cannot become a permanent excuse. Remove an entry as soon as the underlying drift is fixed — a stale entry is reported as a warning.
